meaning: Polite particle used to make a respectful request.
hand_configuration: Flat open dominant palm placed flat on upper chest, stroking downward gently with slight forward head bow.
isl_grammar_structure: Modality marker: attaches before or after request predicate (e.g. HELP PLEASE).
cultural_linguistic_notes: Essential social register marker used when requesting aid or services at public counters.

media.description: Flat palm smoothing downward on chest in courteous plea.
